description: Defines the HpackVarintDecoder class for decoding HPACK variable length unsigned integers, supporting resumable decoding, with details on encoding, limits, and usage in HTTP/2 and QPACK.

classes.name: HpackVarintDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding HPACK variable length unsigned integers in a resumable fashion, supporting up to 10 extension bytes, used in HTTP/2 and QPACK implementations.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes decoding with the first byte and prefix length, starting the decoding process.

methods.name: StartExtended
methods.description: Begins decoding when multiple bytes are required, after the initial byte indicates extension.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding after an earlier call indicated that decoding was in progress.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the decoded value, mainly for testing or optimization.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state for debugging.

methods.name: StartForTest
methods.description: Test version of Start, used for benchmarking.

methods.name: StartExtendedForTest
methods.description: Test version of StartExtended, used for benchmarking.

methods.name: ResumeForTest
methods.description: Test version of Resume, used for benchmarking.
